notes: The form prints no boxes: it is an indented sample outline, numbered with a trailing period at every level ('1.1.1.1.'). In the text block each two spaces of indentation is one printed indent level. The five branches under Project (People, Equipment, Materials, Supplies, Locations) are the printed resource categories; the leaf entries are sample placeholders. The form has no Document Element table.
